services.name: Bridal Makeup (HD / Airbrush)
services.description: Complete royal bridal transformation with waterproof HD/Airbrush base, bespoke contouring, lashes, premium eye artistry, hair styling, and jewelry setting.
services.benefits: 16-hour sweat-proof stay, camera-ready luminosity, includes luxury skin prep

services.name: Party Makeup & Hair Styling
services.description: Glamorous evening and festive party makeup designed to complement your designer outfit with modern glowing finish and complementary hair do.
services.benefits: Long-lasting dewy or matte finish, sculpted cheekbones, winged or smokey eye artistry

services.name: Engagement Makeup
services.description: Elegant romantic makeup look curated specifically for ring ceremonies and intimate sangeet gatherings.
services.benefits: Pastel and shimmer palettes tailored to your pastel lehenga or gown

services.name: Reception Makeup
services.description: High-impact couture glam with sculpted definition, bold lips or dramatic eyes suited for grand wedding reception stages.
services.benefits: Stage-lighting tested, high pigment definition, includes hair accessory placement

services.name: Hair Styling & Updos
services.description: Designer bridal buns, textured messy braids, Hollywood waves, floral poola jada setting, and heat-protective styling.
services.benefits: Firm hold that endures dancing and humidity, real flower anchoring

services.name: Traditional Saree Draping
services.description: Flawless crisp pleating and styling in South Indian bridal, Kanjeevaram, Gujarati, Bengali, or Modern Mermaid draping.
services.benefits: Pre-pleating option, ironed pin placement, zero discomfort or slippage

services.name: Makeup Trial Consultation
services.description: Half-face makeup trial and personal skin tone match, bridal look consultation, and product patch test prior to your big day.
services.benefits: Deducted from final bridal booking if finalized, personalized beauty checklist

services.name: Signature Haircut & Blow Dry
services.description: Custom layered hair design and face-framing cuts by our senior stylists, followed by Moroccan oil blow dry.
services.benefits: Adds bounce, removes split ends, includes revitalizing wash

services.name: L’Oréal Majirel Global Hair Colour
services.description: Rich vibrant color transformation or 100% grey coverage with nourishing ionène G and incell formula.
services.benefits: Deep conditioning gloss, high multidimensional shine, long-lasting hue

services.name: Keratin Smoothing & Protein Therapy
services.description: Intense anti-frizz formaldeyhde-free smoothing system that transforms unruly waves into silky, manageable tresses.
services.benefits: Up to 4 months of frizz-free humidity resistance, cuts styling time in half

services.name: Biolage Moroccan Oil Deep Hair Spa
services.description: Therapeutic scalp massage with botanical hair mask, micro-mist hydration steam, and serum lock-in.
services.benefits: Relieves stress, nourishes dry flaky scalp, strengthens hair follicles

services.name: O3+ Bridal Radiance & Whitening Facial
services.description: Award-winning European formulation facial with oxygenating peel, micro-circulation ampoule, and 24k gold rubber mask.
services.benefits: Instantly banishes dullness, lightens pigmentation, leaves unmatched glass-skin glow

services.name: Hydra Deep Pore Infusion Facial
services.description: Multi-step skin resurfacing treatment combining vortex vacuum suction extraction, hyaluronic acid infusion, and LED phototherapy.
services.benefits: Clears blackheads, deeply plumps fine lines, ultra-hydrating without downtime

services.name: Lotus Organic Phyto-Rx Skin Glow
services.description: Pure plant botanical treatment enriched with bilberry, grape fruit extracts, and pure vitamin C.
services.benefits: Gentle on sensitive skin, fights environmental pollution damage

services.name: Aroma Relaxation Full Body Therapy
services.description: Swedish effleurage massage with warm lavender and ylang-ylang essential oils, followed by calming herbal steam.
services.benefits: Relieves muscle stiffness, enhances lymphatic drainage, promotes deep restorative sleep

services.name: Deep Tissue & Hot Stone Stress Relief
services.description: Targeted firm pressure massage using smooth heated basalt volcanic stones to melt chronic neck and back tension.
services.benefits: Improves blood circulation, releases muscle knots from desk fatigue

services.name: Full Body Botanical Scrub & Polish
services.description: Luxurious full-body exfoliation with dead sea minerals, walnut micro-granules, and moisturizing shea butter mask.
services.benefits: Buffs away dead cells, softens elbows & knees, leaves velvety silk touch

services.name: Full Body Herbal De-Tan Brightening
services.description: Kojic acid and eucalyptus herbal pack applied across full arms, legs, and back to reverse sun damage and uneven pigmentation.
services.benefits: Visible tan removal in single session, cooling and soothing after outdoor exposure

services.name: Luxury Crystal Pedicure Ritual
services.description: Effervescent crystal salt soak, callus smoothing, foot exfoliation scrub, cooling mint clay mask, and reflexology massage.
services.benefits: Relieves tired feet, heals cracked heels, includes clean cuticle detailing and shine buff

services.name: Rose Petal Aroma Manicure
services.description: Fresh rose petal infused warm soak, almond scrub, cuticle conditioning, hand massage, and long-lasting gel polish application.
services.benefits: Hydrates dry cuticles, prevents brittle nails, flawless chip-resistant finish

services.name: Designer Nail Art & French Extension Polish
services.description: Bespoke nail art with chrome powder, gold foil accents, or classic micro-french tips over gel overlay.
services.benefits: Lasts up to 3 weeks without fading or chipping

packages.description: Comprehensive pre-bridal and wedding day package: O3+ Bridal Radiance Facial, Full Body Botanical Polish, HD Bridal Makeup, Saree Draping, and Hair Styling.

reviews.comment: Booked my wedding sangeet and reception makeup with Fatima at The Glossy Looks. The waterproof HD finish stayed fresh through 7 hours of dancing and photos. Absolutely flawless!
The O3+ Bridal Glow facial and Crystal Pedicure gave my skin instant radiance. Impeccable hygiene and the staff is so gentle and polite. My go-to salon in Gachibowli!
Got hair botox and rose petal manicure done. The blow dry lasted 3 full days with incredible shine. Their online appointment booking via WhatsApp is so convenient and smooth.
